summary: A sign-in card: email, password with a show toggle, an optional passkey and the links around them. A mistake shakes the form instead of only printing a message.

props.name: description
props.example: Welcome back. Your files are where you left them.

props.name: onSignIn
props.description: Called with the email and password once both are filled in and the email reads as one. Return or resolve a message to show it under the password and shake the form.

props.name: passkeyLabel
props.description: The label of a second way in under the form. No button renders without it.

props.name: onPasskey
props.description: Called when the passkey button is pressed.

props.name: forgotHref
props.description: Where "Forgot password?" leads. No link renders without it.

props.name: signUpHref
props.description: Where "Create an account" leads. No line renders without it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the card. Its fields and buttons keep their own.

props.name: animated
props.description: The form shakes when it is sent with a mistake. Turn it off for a form that stays still; it is off anyway when the user has asked for reduced motion.
Welcome back. Your files are where you left them.
